cover.title: Brightwater Distribution Co. -- FY2025 Revenue Bridge (FY2024 to FY2025)
cover.engagement: Initial financial diligence -- revenue movement analysis
assumptions: Explanation threshold: $250,000 (agreed with deal lead before any figure computed).

FY2024 revenue (44,120,000) is assumed to already be on the gross (pre-reclass) presentation basis, since notes_fy2025.md states the freight netting began in FY2025 and 'prior years presented it in revenue' -- so FY2024 vs FY2025-gross is treated as like-for-like for the growth driver.

Lakeside Grocers new-contract dollar impact ($2,937,000) is an approximation: the source document states only 'approximately 6% of consolidated revenue', applied to FY2025 reported revenue of $48,950,000 -- not an exact figure from a source.

The $2,143,000 'other/unattributed organic growth' bar is a plug-free labeled residual of the growth driver, NOT an unexplained bridge remainder (the bridge itself foots exactly to zero) -- it is carried as its own open item because it cannot be decomposed into named drivers from the sources available.
